# Serendipity Technology

> Fractional CTO leadership and custom software development, delivered by a senior engineer who directs AI to build real software fast. Receipts over hype.

## About

Serendipity Technology is led by Troy Shimkus, a working engineer who practices AI-directed engineering: the engineer owns architecture, security, and the final call, and AI does the heavy lifting under that direction. Based in Volusia County, Florida, serving organizations nationwide.

## What we do

- **Fractional CTO**: Part-time technology leadership for organizations that cannot hire a full-time CTO. Strategy, architecture and security review, vendor decisions, hiring and contractor oversight, and AI adoption.
- **Custom Software Development**: Web apps, internal tools, portals, workflow automation, and data integration, AI-accelerated and engineered to last.

## What we have built

- Upfront: quotes, approvals, invoices, and online payments for service businesses (https://serendipitytechnology.com/services/upfront)
- Membership Database: multitenant membership platform for clubs, chapters, and nonprofits
- PrecinctWins: precinct-level voter data and outreach platform (https://precinctwins.com)
- Multi-store commerce, event check-in, and other client platforms (see Recent Projects on the homepage)
